vulnerability.name: USN-5686-4
vulnerability.description: USN-5686-1 fixed several vulnerabilities in Git. This update provides the corresponding fix for CVE-2022-39253 on Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.   Original advisory details:   Cory Snider discovered that Git incorrectly handled certain symbolic links.  An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause an unexpected behaviour.

statements.status_notes: Git could be made to expose sensitive information. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
